headline: Executive order sets a federal standard for how government agencies manage earthquake risk.
what_it_does: This order creates a federal standard for managing earthquake risk. Based on its title, it appears to set rules federal agencies must follow to reduce earthquake danger, likely for buildings the government owns, leases, or pays for. No summary was provided, so the exact requirements and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would be expected to follow a common standard for managing earthquake risk in their work and facilities.

who_it_affects.group: People who work in or visit federal buildings
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected if the standard leads to safer building design or upgrades in earthquake-prone areas.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 2, 2016; specific compliance deadlines are not stated in the provided material.
